title: The Demon Poison Spot
summary: Medusa and Xiao Yan capture Protector Tie, and Little Fairy Doctor beats Xie Biyan with the blood of her Woeful Poison Body. Dying, Xie Biyan uses his life force to plant the Demon Poison Spot in Xiao Yan, which kills in half a year and can only be cured by a Dou Zun. Medusa kills Xie Biyan and vows to wipe out the Ten Thousand Scorpion Gate. Little Fairy Doctor uses a poison pool and her own meridians to suppress the spot for two years. Xiao Yan refines one poison vein and reaches the peak of Two-Star Dou Huang. Protector Tie says the Hall of Souls has Man, Earth and Sky Protectors and a branch at Burial Stream in the Sky Heart Empire. Xiao Yan decides to seek the Dou Zun dean of Jia Nan Academy, with Little Fairy Doctor and Zi Yan.
